opening.argument: The video demonstrates a practical Chrome connection fix through direct navigation of server, proxy, and LAN settings. It instructs the viewer to change the server and proxy configuration, open LAN settings, remove the marked setting, and confirm by pressing OK, followed by the stated expectation that the problem will not recur. The visible Chrome connection-error page and successive connection-settings and LAN-settings dialogs match those instructions. The Facebook contact address is presented only as a communication method, with no financial offer, payment requirement, credential request, or deceptive participation flow.

citations.quote: Then change the server and the proxy set. Then we go into the LAN set. Then we drop the health tag from here. And we press OK.
Then the problem will not appear with you again.
